Identified as this saint because: The Menologion miniature of the martyrs Hermylus and Stratonicus drowned at Belgrade pairs the folder's deacon Hermylus with its related saint stratonicus-companion-of-hermylus, on 13 January under Licinius. Commons describes it: Мученики Ермил и Стратоник Константинополь. 985 г. Миниатюра Минология Василия II.  Ватиканская библиотека. Рим.
